videos.title: These Potatoes are Buttermaxxing
videos.author: Bon Appétit
videos.description:
Crispy on the outside, buttery and meltingly tender inside. Pommes Anna is a classic French potato dish made by layering thinly sliced potatoes with clarified butter and salt. The result is a golden, crispy potato cake with a rich, melt-in-your-mouth center.
